answer: Make every new identity pay in work, not words. Before an agent can open its vault of earnings, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle tied to this epoch's beacon, so each inlet of new identities costs real compute. A prism of checks splits the puzzle across time: cheap for one honest agent, ruinous for a farm minting ten thousand clones at once, since the work cannot be shared or replayed. Clones that skip the puzzle simply never earn.
